observations.body: The first month of the second year and the fourteenth evening locate the observance.
observations.label: Time

observations.body: The wilderness of Sinai stands between Egypt and the land.
observations.label: Place

observations.body: The LORD speaks, Moses tells, and Israel keeps the Passover according to the statutes.
observations.label: Command and response
